content: गमनम् [गम्-ल्युट्] .²1 Going, motion, gait; श्रोणीभारादलसगमना <ls>Me. 84</ls>; so गजेन्द्रगमने <ls>Ś. Til. 7</ls>. .²2 Going, motion; considered as one of the five {%karmans%} by the Vaiśeṣikas. .²3 Approaching, going to. .²4 March of an assailant. .²5 Undergoing, suffering. .²6 Obtaining, attaining. .²7 Cohabitation. .²8 Knowledge, understanding; नाञ्जः स्वरूपगमने प्रभवन्ति भूम्नः <ls>Bhāg. 8. 7. 34</ls>.
